messages:
Aisha N: Hey @People Ops quick one 1FTE here (2.5 days/week). There was a national bank holiday during our Dec maintenance blackout and I couldn't take it. Is carryover automatic or do I need to file anything?
People Ops: Hi Aisha short answer: you need to file the blackout-exception form so we have manager confirmation. For part-time staff we pro-rate and can either carry the entitlement or do a payout depending on preference and local rules.
Aisha N: I prefer a floating day next year instead of payout. Is that allowed?
People Ops: We allow carryover as a fixed pro-rated day up to the carryover cap (policy cap = 1 statutory day). For part-time that may be a fractional day (we'll convert to hours). If you want a floating day instead of adding fractional hours to your balance, select "convert to floating day" in the form and get manager sign-off.
Aisha N: Where's the form?
People Ops: https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception
Tom B: I confirm Aisha was staffing the on-call roster that day and couldn't take the holiday. I'll add a manager note on the form tonight. +1 for floating day.
Aisha N: Thanks Tom. Any payroll timing concerns if we choose payout instead later?
Payroll Bot: Note: payroll cutoff for Dec adjustments is Nov 20. Payout requests received after that will roll to the next payroll cycle.
People Ops: Good to know. If you're converting to a floating day there's no payroll cutoff, we'll adjust time-off balance. If you opt for payout, file and indicate "payout" and include desired payroll run.
Aisha N: Submitted form with Tom's note, chose "convert to floating day" and marked urgent.
People Ops: Received and opened case HR-2026-5188. We'll calculate pro-rated hours (2.5/5 = 0.5 of a day -> converted to 4 hours) and apply as a floating day on next leave cycle. Expect confirmation in 3 business days.
calendar-bot: FYI company maintenance blackout Dec 23-27. See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
Aisha N: Awesome, thanks! Appreciate the quick turnaround.
People Ops: You're welcome closing note: remember carryover cap = 1 statutory day; if multiple holidays fall in a blackout we'll handle per-case.
